input.sql:
select 'tot', sum(cast(amount as real)), count(*) from data where service_date between '2025-07-01' and '2025-09-30' and instr(amount,',')=0 and amount glob '*[0-9]*' and amount not glob '*[^0-9.]*'
union all select 'all', avg(cast(amount as real)), count(*) from data where instr(amount,',')=0 and amount<>'' and amount not glob '*[^0-9.]*'
union all select 'q3rows', 0, count(*) from data where service_date between '2025-07-01' and '2025-09-30'
union all select coalesce(nullif(region,''),'UNKNOWN'), sum(cast(amount as real)), count(*) from data where service_date between '2025-07-01' and '2025-09-30' and instr(amount,',')=0 and amount<>'' and amount not glob '*[^0-9.]*' group by 1
